Monologue: What interesting times we are living in, friend.
Chaos is erupting around us, but here you are, still cooking.
I had a test in mind for you, but oddly, the subjects are strangely missing. Was it due to your fear, or were you somehow aware of my intentions?
Do you wish for me to spoil the surprise of the fates of those you had rejected? Or perhaps, through some strange intervention, you already know?
How I wish we could talk.
Only then could I come to understand the nature that guides you.
You see, friend, I am here to learn more about this city on behalf of my…superiors. The Spoilage here is something they are greatly interested in.
I watch, just like you, of all the folks who live within this city. When I act, it is to *experiment*. And you, my friend, are the final subject.
You can return to your work in peace. This is our final goodbye, friend. I hope you enjoy what's left.
